newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: BOE Private Bank, Coutts form alliance.
newsitem.headline: BOE Private Bank, Coutts form alliance.

text.p: Board of Executors Ltd subsidiary BOE Private Bank said on Thursday it had formed a strategic alliance with international private banking group Coutts.
London-based Coutts is a subsidiary of the NatWest Group, which formed a 50-50 joint venture partnership with BOE in September 1995.
Announcing the alliance, BOE Private Bank managing director Brian Bechet said it "places us in a position where it gives us immediate access to a global, world class network.

"Not only do we have existing clients who have portions of their family wealth offshore, but as and when exchange controls are further dismantled, it places us in a position where instantly those clients will have access to an institution like Coutts."
Coutts chief executive officer David Went said that many of the bank's clients were interested in investing in South Africa and would be able to tap into BOE's knowledge of the market.

Clients in the UK, for example, were interested in residential property, "but I have a Malaysian client who is interested in using South Africa as a base in terms of manufacturing for the Southern African market," Went said.
The alliance does not involve the creation of a new company or cross-shareholdings but rather an exclusive, formal agreement to work together.
